name: io.github.cwasley/earnrate
title: earnrate
description: Which credit card earns the most at a merchant, from your cards or every card, and why.

environmentVariables.name: EARNRATE_WALLET
environmentVariables.description: Path to your wallet file. Default: ~/.earnrate/wallet.yaml

environmentVariables.name: EARNRATE_LLM
environmentVariables.description: Set to on to let Claude classify merchants earnrate doesn't know. Off by default.

environmentVariables.name: EARNRATE_LLM_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: The Claude model for merchant lookups, when EARNRATE_LLM is on.

environmentVariables.name: EARNRATE_LLM_MAX_CALLS
environmentVariables.description: Most Claude merchant lookups per session, when EARNRATE_LLM is on.

environmentVariables.name: EARNRATE_MERCHANT_CACHE
environmentVariables.description: Where Claude's merchant answers are saved. Default: ~/.earnrate/merchant-cache.json

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your own Anthropic key, used only when EARNRATE_LLM is on.
